content: {"action":"bill_secondary","reasoning":"Meridian denied for missing prior authorization, and its 30-day retro-authorization window is closed; it also offers no peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or another records submission would not cure the authorization defect, while billing the patient for the full balance would exceed the contractual patient share. With COB order correct and secondary coverage confirmed, the proper next action is to bill the secondary payer with the primary denial."}
